subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ecstatic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ecstatic"** means feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement. (उत्साहित, आनंदमय)

 
 
• **Example: **She was ecstatic when she heard the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Happy"** refers to feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. (खुश)
 
 
• **Example: **He was happy to spend time with his family over the weekend.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for "Ecstatic" is "Happy."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shocked** (चौंक जाना): A sudden feeling of surprise or distress caused by something unexpected.

 
 
• **Example: **She was shocked to find out about the accident.
 
 
 
• **Angry** (गुस्से में): Feeling or showing strong annoyance or displeasure.
 
 
• **Example: **He was angry when he found out someone had scratched his car.
 
 
 
• **Interested** (रुचि रखना): Showing curiosity or concern about something; eager to know or learn.
 
 
• **Example: **She is interested in learning about different cultures.
